title: 第7章 造化道果万条灵脉第8章 指点一二五体投地
slug: 无敌帝祖第620章一剑杀了
content_zh:
林晨踏入清幽山的顷刻间，健步如飞。
若是旁人见到这一幕，恐怕会瞠目结舌，很难相信这是一个未开脉少年。
尽管漆黑深夜，他肌肤表面，似有金色符文闪烁。
一路轻车熟路，很快就来到清幽山一处山谷。
嗷！
一声狼嚎声响起。
就见到一只通体雪白的狼，身长三米多，两只眼睛闪烁着光芒，四肢粗壮有力，眨眼间就跳跃到林晨身前。
伸出脑袋在林晨的肩膀上面蹭了蹭，银白色的毛发格外柔软。
“怎么了？小狼，想我了吗？”
林晨伸出手拍了拍银月雪狼的脑袋，脸上带着笑意。
银月雪狼迫不及待点点头。
竟然能够听懂林晨的话语。
这是一头变异的银月雪狼，别看它身躯庞大，也就仅仅两岁多而已。
两年之前，林晨在清幽山淬炼身躯。
恰好无意中碰到两只妖兽争斗。
银月雪狼和烈火暴熊一番厮杀后，银月雪狼当场战死。
林晨就准备吞噬银月雪狼的血液淬炼身躯，却没想到发现银月雪狼的肚子里面，竟然还有只幼崽。
也就是面前的小狼。
一番检查之下，他发现小狼的母亲虽然只是寻常的银月雪狼，它却是传说中的变异银月雪狼，体内返祖觉醒了独有的血脉。
林晨就顺手将它养在清幽山山谷，并且传授小家伙修炼之法。

正好他时不时就要来清幽山淬炼肉身，有小狼作伴，也挺好。
“最近修炼有没有偷懒？”
林晨对着小狼问道。
嗷！
银月雪狼紧接着再次发出一声怒吼，雪白的毛发之上弥漫着银色的光芒，怒吼声中夹带着威压。
眼睛里面都是激动的光芒，宛如孩童一般在林晨面前炫耀。
“不错，不错，竟然突破到了三阶！”
林晨对着小狼点点头。
人类武者的修炼境界，分别是开脉境、融血境、通神境、气海境、元婴境、造化境、真武境、大宗师境、大能境、尊者、半圣、圣境……
妖兽的境界就简单很多，分别是从一阶到九阶，九阶对应人类武者的大能境，往往超越九阶的妖兽，大多数都已经幻化成为人形。
也就是面前的小狼，已经是堪比通神境存在。
再加上妖兽的肉身比人类武者强悍不少，寻常通神境武者，极有可能不是小狼的对手。
就目前林晨所在大衍皇朝，修为最强大的也就是大能境。
弘丰城的最强者，也仅仅是气海境。
小狼听到林晨的夸奖，显得很激动。
紧接着。
林晨带着小狼，朝着山谷深处走去。
“小狼，你帮我盯着点。”
来到山谷深处，林晨径直来到一块平坦的石板上，盘膝而坐，眼眸深处也浮现出期待。
他自从修炼《九转轮回诀》以来，前九世轮回均达到了很高的成就。

越是境界越高，就越觉得不够完美。
轮回第十世，他的灵魂先在无尽虚空磨炼十万年，将灵魂淬炼的更加纯粹精致。
然后再以天地灵力滋养，孕育先天道胎，以凡人之躯重新修炼，他要做的就是将身躯修炼成为至高无上的至尊道体，将灵魂淬炼成为天地灵魂。
伴随着林晨闭上双眼，脑海里面浮现出一本古朴苍凉卷轴，就见到上面浮现出密密麻麻金色符文。
林晨心念一动，那些金色符文竟然从卷轴上飞出来，以一种大循环的规律，朝着他的身体流动而去。
content_en:
The moment Lin Chen stepped into Qingyou Mountain, his steps were as fast as flying.
If others saw this scene, they would probably be stunned and find it difficult to believe that this was a young man without a pulse.
Despite the darkness of the night, golden runes seemed to flicker on the surface of his skin.
After traveling on a familiar road, we soon arrived at a valley in Qingyou Mountain.
Ouch!
A wolf howled.
Then he saw a snow-white wolf, more than three meters long, with twinkling eyes and thick and powerful limbs. It jumped in front of Lin Chen in the blink of an eye.
He stretched out his head and rubbed Lin Chen's shoulder. The silver-white hair was particularly soft.
"What's wrong? Little Wolf, do you miss me?"
Lin Chen reached out and patted Silver Moon Snow Wolf on the head with a smile on his face.
Silver Moon Snow Wolf nodded eagerly.
He was actually able to understand Lin Chen's words.
This is a mutated Silver Moon Snow Wolf. Despite its huge body, it is only over two years old.
Two years ago, Lin Chen was training his body in Qingyou Mountain.
I just happened to encounter two monsters fighting.
After a fight between Silver Moon Snow Wolf and Raging Fire Bear, Silver Moon Snow Wolf died on the spot.
Lin Chen was about to swallow the Silver Moon Snow Wolf's blood to temper his body, but he didn't expect to find that there was a cub in the Silver Moon Snow Wolf's belly.
That is the little wolf in front of me.
After some inspection, he discovered that although the little wolf's mother was just an ordinary Silver Moon Snow Wolf, she was actually the legendary mutated Silver Moon Snow Wolf, with a unique bloodline awakened in her body.
Lin Chen conveniently raised it in the quiet mountain valley and taught the little guy how to practice.
It just so happened that he would come to Qingyou Mountain from time to time to temper his body, so it was good to have Little Wolf as his companion.
"Have you been lazy in your practice recently?"
Lin Chen asked Xiaolang.
Ouch!
The Silver Moon Snow Wolf then let out another roar, its snow-white hair filled with silver light, and its roar was filled with pressure.
His eyes were filled with excitement, showing off in front of Lin Chen like a child.
"Not bad, not bad, we actually broke through to the third level!"
Lin Chen nodded to Xiaolang.
The cultivation realms of human warriors are respectively the Pulse Opening Realm, the Blood Melting Realm, the Divine Realm, the Qi Sea Realm, the Nascent Soul Realm, the Creation Realm, the True Martial Realm, the Grand Master Realm, the Powerful Realm, the Venerable Realm, the Semi-Saint Realm, and the Holy Realm...
The realm of monsters is much simpler, ranging from the first to the ninth level. The ninth level corresponds to the powerful realm of human warriors. Most of the monsters that often surpass the ninth level have transformed into human forms.
That is to say, the little wolf in front of him is already comparable to a being in the realm of spiritual connection.
In addition, the physical bodies of monster beasts are much stronger than human warriors. It is very likely that ordinary warriors in the realm of spiritual connection will not be Xiaolang's opponent.
In the current Dayan Dynasty where Lin Chen resides, the one with the most powerful cultivation level is the Great Power Realm.
The strongest person in Hongfeng City is only in the Qi Sea realm.
Xiaolang looked very excited when he heard Lin Chen's compliment.
Immediately afterwards.
Lin Chen took the little wolf and walked towards the depths of the valley.
"Little Wolf, help me keep an eye on it."
Arriving at the depths of the valley, Lin Chen walked straight to a flat stone slab and sat cross-legged, with expectations deep in his eyes.
Since he practiced the "Nine Revolutions of Reincarnation Technique", he has achieved very high achievements in his first nine reincarnations.
The higher your level, the less perfect you feel.
In the tenth reincarnation, his soul was tempered in the endless void for a hundred thousand years, tempering the soul to become more pure and refined.
Then he nourishes it with the spiritual power of heaven and earth, gives birth to the innate Tao embryo, and practices it again in a mortal body. What he has to do is to cultivate his body into the supreme Tao body, and temper his soul into the soul of heaven and earth.
As Lin Chen closed his eyes, an ancient and desolate scroll appeared in his mind, and he saw dense golden runes appearing on it.
As Lin Chen thought, those golden runes flew out from the scroll and flowed towards his body in a large cycle.
